caption: The drawing depicts a square piece of fabric with a deep red background and black floral patterns. The fabric has a short, white fringe along its left and bottom edges. The black floral design consists of large, intricate clusters of flowers and swirling leaves. The main concentration of the floral pattern runs diagonally from the bottom left corner up to the upper left and upper right corners, forming a dense border along two adjacent edges. An additional floral cluster appears in the upper right, more centrally placed in that quadrant. The center and lower right portion of the fabric remain largely unpatterned, showing mainly the solid red background. The overall color palette consists primarily of dark black and vibrant red, with the white fringe as an accent.
title: Table Cover
